messages:
Sasha Ivanov: quick thread  noticed in the dashboard table the action column gets insanely cramped at compact density. the primary action button overlaps the ellipsis menu on certain widths and testers tapped the wrong control.
Priya Rao: yikes. saw same in the lab. on 11" screens with 3 columns visible the cell padding collapses and the hit targets drop below 40px. we should avoid <44px tap targets.
Oliver Wu: is this a spacing token problem? table-row uses spacing-compact-01 which is 4px. bumping to compact-02 (8px) for action cells might help. but need to check overall row height impact.
Marcos Alvarez: dev constraints: increasing row height affects virtualization math. we'll need to test on the virtualized table component; small increases can cause jitter if measurements change. alternative: expand action hit target using pseudo elements so visual density is unchanged.
a11y-bot: a11y note: "Interactive controls must be at least 44x44 CSS pixels for touch. Provide keyboard focus styles and accessible names for icon-only buttons."
Sasha Ivanov: microcopy: the ellipsis menu currently shows 'More actions' but users didn't understand one-off items (e.g., 'Open in editor'). maybe we should show the primary action as a CTA and secondary actions in the menu.
Priya Rao: agree. recommendation: primary = 'Run' (solid small button), secondary actions under kebab. For rows with a single important action show label+icon; for crowded rows show only icon with tooltip.
Oliver Wu: tooltip reliance is risky on mobile. if we show label on narrow widths, it increases width. propose responsive rule: if container width < 420px switch to stacked actions: big primary full-width button above row details, collapse others into menu.
Marcos Alvarez: prototype CSS snippet to expand hit target without affecting layout:
```
.action-btn { position: relative; }
.action-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; pointer-events: none; }
.action-btn > button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
```
Note: pointer-events none on pseudo prevents it blocking clicks but doesn't increase tap target for assistive tech; recommend using an actual button wrapper when possible.
Sasha Ivanov: good point. also we should update tokens: table-row-height-compact -> 36px to 40px for compact density? that might reduce individual content per viewport but improve usability. UX trade-off call needed.
Priya Rao: propose A/B: A) keep density but add tappable padding via wrapper (no layout change), B) increase compact row height to 40px and adjust virtualization threshold. run quick usability with 8 participants to see error rate.
Oliver Wu: I'll spin up a small branch implementing wrapper-hit-target + kebab-first reorder so primary action is visually distinct. will include keyboard focus tests.
Marcos Alvarez: devops note: changing row height affects metrics for infinite scroll; will add a migration flag for the virt-table to recalc sizes on mount.
a11y-bot: follow-up: "Ensure icon-only buttons have aria-labels and visible focus outline. Do not rely solely on color or hover for affordance."
Sasha Ivanov: microcopy decisions: primary action label 'Run' vs 'Open' vs 'View' depends on table context. I'll add a11y label guidance in the component docs: "label should describe action + object (e.g., 'Run job', 'Open workspace')"
Priya Rao: can you also add examples of stacked actions for <420px and a token map for row-height changes? I'll validate with design ops.
Sasha Ivanov: will post mocks tonight in #design. leaving thread open until PR + token proposal merged. tagging @Oliver for implementation and @Marcos for infra review. :thumbsup:
Oliver Wu: got it — will link PR here when ready.
